# One row per census key and host group. The route column is an EXPLICIT comma-separated host list
# (no wildcards); the FIRST host is the witness the template targets; more than one host requires a
# reason giving the equivalence argument. Split-construct hosts (preproc_*, *split*, *fragmented*) have
# their own row at every non-interior position. Task 4 filled it (2026-10-06, fix round 1).
# plain = the directive-free valid filling of the hole (\n = newline); required for every templated row.
# HOLE: list-/edge-separator = the whole list at that site (inside one #if arm when the witness is a conditional);
# continuation = the expression in the slot; terminator = the preceding element plus the token; fixed-separator =
# the element on each side plus the token (token alone only where no directive-free element precedes it on its line).
# Templates use TPL for their own directives and TPL2 for a split host's; every filled template compiles (alc, every
